get.summary: Galaxy subsystem boundary contract & coupling analysis

Returns comprehensive macro topology metrics across all galaxies for the Subsystem Topology Hub.

post.description: Scans directory, extracts polyglot AST symbols (Rust, Go, TS, Python, Java, C/C++), computes 384-d embeddings, stores graph in SurrealDB, and auto-clusters. Serialized via internal FIFO queue to eliminate SurrealDB write conflicts. Auto-purges old workspace data for guaranteed clean integrity.

refresh.description: Clean re-scan (default true when workspace exists)

watch.description: Auto-enroll filesystem live-watch daemon upon completion

async.description: If true, queues job and returns immediately with HTTP 202 Accepted
